en: A .benv naming whichever of the two were written. It holds no pixels, so it needs at least one of them.

The image-based lighting: the specular and diffuse convolutions of the same radiance. Minutes of work, where the sky is moments -- uncheck it to re-author a backdrop without paying for the lighting again.
The backdrop: one radiance cube map, projected from the source.
Subfolder of Derived/EnvLighting/ to write the .benvl into.
Names every file this import writes: Derived/Sky/<name>.bsky, Derived/EnvLighting/<name>.benvl, Authored/Environments/<name>.benv and their sources.
Subfolder of Derived/Sky/ to write the .bsky into. The category itself is fixed: every reference in the project is written against it.

Subfolder of Authored/EnvSources/ for the copy of the file being imported, and the .bimport beside it. Together they are what re-produces this environment in a checkout that does not carry the derived files.
